handler.description: Handler name registered in the server's `HandlerRegistry`.

args.description: Handler-specific arguments — opaque to the IR.

context.description: Page-level context that originated the action.

ActionContext.description: Per-fire client-supplied context. `target` is a component id for SDUI button actions and a node path for kind-action handlers; the discriminator is the handler shape.

target.description: Component id (SDUI flow) **or** node path (kind-action flow) that originated the action.

stack.description: Ordered nav-node ids forming the breadcrumb stack.

page_state.description: Page-local state at the moment the action fired. Capped server-side per R8 (64 KiB).

auth_subject.description: Opaque auth subject identifier threaded through for audit.
